events.summary: Speaker A stated the project is to make a new remote control that is original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: We're gonna make a new remote control that's um original, trendy and also user-friendly

events.summary: Speaker A set the process: functional design first, then conceptual design, then detailed design, each with individual work followed by a meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: We're gonna have discuss the functional design first

events.summary: Speaker A stated the remote has to operate the TV.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it has to operate T_V_, blah blah blah

events.summary: Speaker A stated the selling price for the remote will be twenty-five euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the selling price for our remote is going to be twenty-five Euro

events.summary: Speaker A stated the profit aim is fifty million euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: our profit aim is fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker A decided the product will be international, marketed in the States, Europe and Asia.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: We're going to make this an international product marketed in the States

events.summary: Speaker A stated the production cost to reach the profit aim must be at most twelve euros fifty per remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: our production cost to make that profit is gonna be a max of twelve fifty Euro per remote

events.summary: Speaker B proposed making a multifunctional remote that controls everything, one remote for all devices.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we wanna make a multifunctional remote, right? One remote for everything

events.summary: Speaker C listed the devices to support: sound system, TV, DVD, VHS and TiVo.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: we have what, sound system, T_V_, D_V_D_, V_H_S_, uh TiVo

events.summary: Speaker B objected to supporting VHS, because VHS will be phased out shortly.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think they'll be phasing V_H_S_ out shortly

events.summary: Speaker D said the remote must be compatible with devices, because universal remotes are never universal.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: It needs to be compatible 'cause universal remote controls are never universal

events.summary: Speaker B said the team must work out how to cover all the different signal variances between devices.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: So we'll have to figure it how to cover all the different variances in signals

events.summary: Speaker D proposed an insanely good instruction booklet, since users must reconfigure their devices for the remote.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: need an insanely good instruction booklet, because you always have to reconfigure

events.summary: Speaker A proposed an ergonomic design that looks high-tech, since users no longer want flat, boring remotes.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: They want the ergonomic ones. Yeah. Ones that ones that look high-tech, too.

events.summary: Speaker D proposed flashy lights as a design feature.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: They want like the flashy lights

events.summary: Speaker C said the remote must still be simple to use.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: But at the same time are simple.

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote must be simple enough for people like Speaker A's mother to use.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: So that people like my mother can use it.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a curvature that matches the curve of a hand.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: What about something with the curvature like that matches the curvature of a hand?

events.summary: Speaker C said most people have double A batteries around, so double A is the practical choice.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: most people usually have double A_s around

events.summary: Speaker D proposed triple A batteries if the remote is to be thinner.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: if we want it to be more thin, then we'd probably wanna go with a triple A_

events.summary: Speaker A deferred the battery decision, noting battery type and size are important to remember.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we don't have to decide about it now, just as long as we remember battery type and size is important

events.summary: Speaker B asked whether the remote can run on a small lithium battery.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Can you with a small lithium battery?

events.summary: Speaker A assigned Speaker C, the marketing person, to write the user requirements specification.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the marketing person, that's Courtney, is going to do the user requirements specification
